mapper.select:
select id, name, short_name as shortName, state, create_by as createBy, update_by as updateBy, create_time, update_time, contact_name, contact_tel, contact_email from pay_isv_info
and short_name = #{isvPageDTO.shortName}
and `name` like concat('%',#{isvPageDTO.name}, '%')
and `contact_name` like concat('%',#{isvPageDTO.contactName}, '%')
